about: The Character page's words (BIBLE 8.4, 18 'Character'). Plain data, read by src/ui/character.js. The page's one verb is the bible's: WEAR. The rungs follow BIBLE 8.4's table in order: tier label and tagline, in-world name, verb perk. A locked rung shows only its number, its tier label and a black silhouette. No level, no experience, no points and no purchase anywhere on this page.
